'''Meliflar Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|spaceport]] made up of miscellaneous pods and modules, with no set design to it. This included a KDY deep-space warehousing module that was used for boarding.

==History==
This station served as a base for smugglers in the [[Mendenbatt system/Legends|Mendenbatt system]]. [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] along with [[Vestara Khai]] encountered this station in their pursuit of [[Abeloth]]. They sensed a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] pulse emanating from it and decided to board. There they were [[Skirmish in Meliflar Station|ambushed]] by the smugglers led by [[Cardya]] who had deposed the former captain, [[Hallaf]] after Abeloth's visit. After a brief skirmish the Skywalkers were led to Hallaf and his daughter [[Fala (Human)|Fala]], who has been tainted by Abeloth's essence. Through healing her, Master Skywalker was able to trace Abeloth's location, [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].
